lines:
classDiagram
    direction LR

    class PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1 {
        +ChatId chatId
        +BranchId branchId
        +CommitId commitId
        +MachineInstanceId machineId
        +BindingGeneration bindingGeneration
        +Hash expectedHeadHash
        +Hash proposedHeadHash
        +PortableRuntimePhaseV1 phase
        +JournalGeneration journalGeneration
        +Hash entryHash
    }

    class PortableRuntimePhaseV1 {
        <<enumeration>>
        PendingPortableCommit
        HeadLinked
        Terminal
        Superseded
        Quarantined
    }

    class LocalFrozenRunBindingV1 {
        +Hash frozenSnapshotHash
        +FrozenRunSnapshotV1 bytesOrContentRef
        +CredentialRef[] credentialRefs
        +AuthorityManifestV1 authorityManifest
        +AuthorityDecisionV1[] authorityDecisions
        +BindingGeneration bindingGeneration
    }

    class PreparedPortableCommitLinkV1 {
        +Hash requestHash
        +Hash preparedObjectSetHash
        +Hash previousHeadHash
        +Hash proposedHeadHash
        +Hash PortableCheckpointRecordV1Hash
        +PortableCommitReceiptV1 verifiedReceipt
    }

    class PendingInteractionStateV1 {
        +ApprovalId[] pendingApprovalIds
        +InputId[] queuedInputIds
        +DeliveryCursor queuedInputCursor
        +Hash payloadSetHash
    }

    class RuntimeDedupOutboxStateV1 {
        +CommandId[] commandDedupIds
        +InvocationId[] invocationDedupIds
        +CapabilityOutcomeV1[] settledDedupOutcomes
        +OutboxId[] dispatchOutboxIds
        +OutboxId[] workerControlOutboxIds
        +DeliveryCursor deliveryCursor
    }

    class PortableRecoveryStateV1 {
        +WorkerCheckpointV1 workerCheckpoint
        +ProcessGeneration coreGeneration
        +ProcessGeneration workerGeneration
        +ProcessGeneration hostGeneration
        +RecoveryCursor recoveryCursor
        +Hash verifiedHeadHash
    }

    PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1 --> PortableRuntimePhaseV1 : has
    PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1 *-- LocalFrozenRunBindingV1 : binds locally
    PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1 *-- PreparedPortableCommitLinkV1 : links exact portable commit
    PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1 *-- PendingInteractionStateV1 : retains pending delivery
    PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1 *-- RuntimeDedupOutboxStateV1 : fences effects and acknowledgements
    PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1 *-- PortableRecoveryStateV1 : resumes without replay

    note for PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1 "Strictly noncanonical. No SemanticEvent or CoreEventEnvelopeV1 stream and never a second history."
    note for PortableRecoveryStateV1 "Stores WorkerCheckpointV1 locally and only a hash or reference to PortableCheckpointRecordV1. LocalLedgerCheckpointV1 belongs to LocalSqlite canonical history."
    note for LocalFrozenRunBindingV1 "CredentialRef only. A copied or imported record grants no authority and a mismatched machine or binding generation is quarantined."

data.title: Portable runtime journal records, stable keys, phases, and noncanonical boundary
